title: Finite4m-8d+7 for d>=3 via unrestricted Ramsey refutation and read-once cover

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. claims: The universal additive constant 6 in the finite inequality C_B2(f)>=4n-8d+6 for every n and every integer d>=2 under the affine-disperser hypothesis cannot be increased: the three-input function h(x,y,z)=xy XOR z is nonconstant on every dimension-2 affine subspace and has full-B2 circuit size exactly two, as proved in elimination.md Section5.5. This is only sharpness of that all-finite-parameter additive constant, not of any leading coefficient.

On eight independent coordinates x,y,hx,hy,p,hp,u,z with D={x*hx=y*hy=p*hp=0}, for EVERY AND-type G=(x+alpha)(y+beta)+gamma and EVERY Boolean function H(G,hx,hy,p,hp,u,z) with no other dependence on x or y, there is a constant affine three-dimensional subspace inside D. There is no size, formula or circuit hypothesis on H. The analytic good-orientation proof and complete normalized bad-orientation coloring refutation are supplied in elimination.md Section5.2 and exactly checked by the declared audit using finite_certificates.txt.

experiments.purpose: Exact standard-library verification of5945 reverse-unit-propagation lemmas refuting all84-state bad-forcing colorings after complete domain/core/group/CNF regeneration, and4082400 normalized read-once assignments across350 tree orbits; also scoped affine-role-exchange, potential, terminal-ledger, algebraic and family predicates. Universal4m-8d+7 for d>=3, all normalization coverage, eligibility and asymptotics are proved in the supplied Markdown.
